verdict.rationale: Persona documents a dedicated sandbox mode with no real verifications/charges, a toggle to force pass/fail states, and Simulate Actions to programmatically evoke inquiry/verification lifecycle outcomes (pass, fail, review) for deterministic integration testing. This directly matches the story's requirement of sandbox-driven deterministic outcome testing. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the simulate actions working as documented, and no explicit mention of documented 'test document' artifacts beyond simulate actions/toggles.
